title: Reported Speech 2 – Pronomen
description: I → he / she, my → his / her, you → I / him …

items.prompt: Ella said, “I like my new bike.”
items.text: Ella said that ___ liked ___ new bike.

items.prompt: Tom and Ben said, “We are doing our homework.”
items.text: Tom and Ben said that ___ were doing ___ homework.

items.prompt: Mum said to me, “You can use my laptop.”
items.text: Mum told me that ___ could use ___ laptop.

items.prompt: Sara said to Tom, “I will help you.”
items.text: Sara told Tom that ___ would help ___.

items.prompt: Dan said, “These books are mine.”
items.text: Dan said that those books were ___.

items.prompt: My sister said to me, “I can borrow your camera.”
items.text: My sister told me that ___ could borrow ___ camera.

items.prompt: Lisa said to us, “I’ll show you my garden.”
items.text: Lisa told us that ___ would show ___ ___ garden.

items.prompt: The kids said, “Our teacher gave us a quiz.”
items.text: The kids said that ___ teacher had given ___ a quiz.

items.prompt: Max said, “I forgot my keys.”
items.text: Max said that ___ had forgotten ___ keys.

items.prompt: Amy and Zoe said, “We love our school.”
items.text: Amy and Zoe said that ___ loved ___ school.

items.prompt: Dad told me, “You must do your homework.”
items.text: Dad told me that ___ had to do ___ homework.

items.prompt: Nina said to Paul, “I miss you.”
items.text: Nina told Paul that ___ missed ___.

items.prompt: “We can’t find our tickets,” the boys said.
items.text: The boys said that ___ could not find ___ tickets.

items.prompt: Mr Hill said to us, “I’ll send you my notes.”
items.text: Mr Hill told us that ___ would send ___ ___ notes.

items.prompt: Kim said, “This is my seat.”
items.text: Kim said that ___ was ___ seat.
items.hint: this → that, und my → his / her. Kim said that that was her seat – zweimal „that“ ist hier richtig.

items.prompt: Ben said to Sue, “Your bag is next to mine.”
items.text: Ben told Sue that ___ bag was next to ___.

items.answer: Ella said that she had lost her purse.
Tom told me that he would help me.

items.prompt: “I have forgotten my umbrella,” Kate said.
answers: Kate said (that) she had forgotten her umbrella.

items.prompt: “We are proud of our team,” the girls said.
answers: The girls said (that) they were proud of their team.

items.prompt: Carl said to me, “I’ll bring you my book.”
answers: Carl told me (that) he would bring me his book.
Carl said (that) he would bring me his book.

items.prompt: Lena said to me, “I can’t help you with your homework.”
answers: Lena told me (that) she could not help me with my homework.
Lena said (that) she could not help me with my homework.

items.prompt: Tom and I said, “We have finished our project.”
answers: Tom and I said (that) we had finished our project.
items.hint: Achtung, Falle: Berichtest du selbst, was du (oder ihr) gesagt hast, bleiben die Pronomen gleich – nur die Zeit verschiebt sich.

items.prompt: “He gave me his phone number,” Sophie said.
answers: Sophie said (that) he had given her his phone number.

items.task: Lies den Dialog und markiere alle Pronomen, die sich in der indirekten Rede ändern.
items.text:
Sam: “Did you and your brother finish your project?”
Mia: “Yes, our parents helped us.”
items.hint: Sam asked Mia if she and her brother had finished their project. Mia said that their parents had helped them.

items.task: Lies den Dialog und markiere alle Pronomen, die sich in der indirekten Rede ändern.
items.text:
Eva: “I forgot my keys at home.”
Tom: “You can use mine.”
items.hint: Eva said that she had forgotten her keys at home. Tom told her that she could use his.

items.task: Lies den Dialog und markiere alle Pronomen, die sich in der indirekten Rede ändern.
items.text:
Lena: “We are late for our lesson.”
Paul: “I know. Your bus was late again.”
items.hint: Lena said that they were late for their lesson. Paul said that he knew and that her bus had been late again.

items.task: Lies den Dialog und markiere alle Pronomen, die sich in der indirekten Rede ändern.
items.text:
Dad: “Have you seen my glasses?”
Anna: “No, I haven't. Ask Mum, she moved them.”
items.hint: Dad asked Anna if she had seen his glasses. Anna said that she hadn't and told him to ask Mum, as she had moved them. – „she“ und „them“ meinen dritte Personen und bleiben.
